name: GitRepoSource
description:
GitRepoSource provisions a workspace by cloning a git repository.

 Only HTTPS clone URLs are supported. SSH URLs are rejected at validation time.

 A private repository is cloned with the entry's own token when it carries
 one, else with a login saved for the repository's host (github.com) in the
 conversation's vaults. The entry's own token is used only for an
 https://github.com repository: a session write carrying a token for any
 other repository is refused.

fields.name: Url
fields.description: HTTPS clone URL for the repository.

fields.name: Branch
fields.description:
Branch to clone.

 When empty, the repository's default branch is used.

fields.name: Commit
fields.description:
Commit SHA to checkout after cloning.

 When set, the workspace is checked out at this exact commit.
 When both branch and commit are set, the branch is cloned first, then
 the commit is checked out.

fields.name: Depth
fields.description:
Number of commits to include in the clone history.

 When not set, defaults to a shallow clone with depth 1. Set to 0 for
 a full clone with complete history.

fields.name: WriteBackMode
fields.description: Controls whether the platform creates a branch and pull request from the agent's file changes.

fields.name: Token
fields.description:
A token for cloning this repository, kept for the conversation only.

 Used only when the URL is an https://github.com repository; a session
 write carrying a token for any other repository is refused. Sealed for
 the conversation's life and never returned by a read. A schedule's
 repositories refuse it: save the token in a vault the schedule names.
